title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds firm at sixty-three thousand five hundred nineteen after a one-point-three percent gain despite extreme fear at twenty-five. Network strength stands out with hashrate at nine hundred forty-three EH/s and block nine hundred sixty thousand nine hundred ninety-six confirming steady production.

Asia session delivered quiet accumulation as mempool backlog hit eighty-eight thousand nine hundred seventy transactions yet fees stayed at one sat per vbyte, signaling light selling pressure.
